_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking one authorized typed content path

description: Discover one unambiguous authorized pair across the current ContentMediaLink.contentData relationship. Search by literal media filename or ContentData body. Writes a bounded retrieval plan and receipt, then returns a current receipt locator and a required typed-evidence caveat. Use compilation and paired hydration for endpoint projections. General graph queries, caller-selected IDs, filters, paths and ambiguous matches are unsupported. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

query.description: Original literal query and subsequent context task. Control characters are unsupported.

seedSource.description: Use media_filename to follow a link to its content record, or content_body to find a content record with one authorized linked media record.

name: context_discover_typed_path
title: Discover one typed content path
